definitions: To cover or obscure something completely, making it difficult or impossible to see.
To intentionally forget or try to remove a memory or thought from one's mind.
To make something illegible or invisible by covering it with ink or another substance.
examples: The clouds blotted out the sun.
He tried to blot out the painful memories.
She blotted out the mistake with a thick marker.
source: to blot out, to obscure, to cover, to hide, to erase, to obliterate, to make illegible, to make invisible
